RESULT [agents]: 42% of experiments failed due to coding errors. Code changed by only about 8% more characters per iteration. Papers had a median of 5 citations, mostly outdated (5 of 34 from 2020 or later). Output resembled 'a rushed undergraduate paper' with hallucinated results. US [agents]: An independent reminder that self-reported success from autonomous research systems differs from independently checked results. Any claim our loop makes about compounding over weeks needs third-party-style reproduction (the one-scorer rule) before it goes into a paper or poster.

US [webresearch]: The agent failure modes we must guard against: fake success, stale or shallow literature, and invented numbers. It supports our verify-don't-claim rule and a single scorer: any number the research agent reports must be recomputed from artifacts.
